captions.detailed: A toroidal ring featuring evenly spaced small spherical nodules protruding from its outer equator. The main body is a smooth, circular torus. The nodules are small, semi-spherical bumps distributed uniformly around the outermost perimeter of the ring.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric toroidal coil core with customizer options for the main ring dimensions. It should feature a user-defined number of small spherical alignment points distributed evenly along the outer equatorial edge.
captions.factory: The design generates a main torus by translating a 2D circle along the X-axis and applying a rotate_extrude operation. A for-loop then places spheres along the outer perimeter, utilizing rotate and translate operations based on the combined poloidal and toroidal radii.
